body:
# Quick QoL
Adds useful gameplay mechanics while preserving the original vanilla Minecraft experience. Most of the mod runs on the server side, but some parts run on the client side for display purposes. --- **_Note: Quick QoL adds helpful mechanics that make gameplay feel more continuous, without changing Minecraft's original vanilla mechanics._** --- ### Features - Adds floating damage indicators - Adds auto item refill with Bucket/Bottle/Bowl support - Adds inventory/chest/container sorting --- ### Key - Shift + Right Click: Inventory/chest/container sorting --- **_Modpack: You may include this mod in public or private modpacks, as long as you provide attribution!_**
